question: Average of 8 values is 36. If 4 is subtracted from each of the first three values and 5 is added in the each of the next five values, then what will be the new average?
solution:
Formula Used:

Mean = Sum of observation/No. of observation

Calculation:

Using the above formula-

⇒ Sum of observation = 36 × 8 = 288

⇒ Change in sum = 5 × 5 - 4 × 3 = 13

⇒ New mean = 301/8 = 37.625

∴ The correct answer is **37.625**.

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
